fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-05-10 states that the complainant reported repeated harassment by a neighbour over a payment settlement near Nallur Garden Residential Colony in Coimbatore, on 2025-05-10 at about 16:00. Contact details given by the complainant, Sangeetha Bai, include the number 9000000261. The complainant alleged that Senthil Krishnan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000461. Siva Muthu (9000000256), described as a co-worker, was also mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Neighbour allegedly used abusive language during a continuing dispute.
